name: set_first_pending_slot_ready
description: Walks a table of eight fixed-size records and, in the first record whose status word is nonzero, sets that word to one and returns; if none qualifies it returns without change.

name: reset_eight_slot_records
description: Calls a helper routine in two loops of eight passes each, then initialises eight consecutive records: it clears the leading and several flag fields, copies the shared global value into four fields, sets a count of eighteen and writes a per-record index byte.

name: clear_and_seed_status_words
description: Zeroes three fixed memory words, sets four other fixed words to the shared global value, and clears one further word.

name: seed_three_word_groups
description: Writes the value one hundred twenty-five to the first word of each of three four-word groups spaced sixty-eight bytes apart, and zeroes the other three words in each group.

name: forward_to_inner_routine
description: Does no work of its own: it calls one other routine and returns.

name: store_constants_between_helper_calls
description: Alternates three calls to a helper routine with three stores of fixed long constants into memory words, the first and last constants being identical.

name: store_five_helper_results
description: Five times over, calls a helper once without using its result, then calls it again to get a 64-bit value and stores its upper and lower 32-bit halves into the shared global in turn. The second store overwrites the first, so only the lower half is kept.

name: set_default_pair_words
description: Calls a helper routine five times around stores of the fixed values one hundred twenty-five and two hundred one into two adjacent words, and zeroes a third word between the calls.

name: build_four_record_table
description: Fills four fifty-byte records in turn: copies a long from a source table, stores a value derived from the shared global pointer, calls a helper, clears most remaining fields, and sets a value of eighty, a sequence index, and a fixed marker word.

name: invoke_helper_five_times
description: Calls one unnamed routine five times in succession and returns, with no other work in its body.

name: copy_indexed_table_block
description: Uses the index in the low word of the data register to select a sixteen-byte table entry, saves two words from it into the shared global, calls a helper, stores the same fixed long constant into two words, and copies thirty-two words from a pointer held in the entry into a fixed buffer.

name: init_two_pointer_table_headers
description: Initialises two structures in turn: each writes a marker word, fills eight consecutive pointer slots with addresses forty bytes apart, then sets fixed fields including values drawn from the shared global pointer and two constants. The second pass uses a different marker and base.

name: init_bitplane_descriptor
description: Clears a forty-byte descriptor and fills in the row byte width, height and depth; the width is the pixel width rounded up to whole sixteen-pixel units. If a destination buffer is supplied, it stores one pointer per plane at equal spacing and copies the source words into the buffer.

name: checksum_descriptor_planes
description: Returns two byte checksums: one sums the forty descriptor bytes, the other sums every byte of each plane's data, sized by row width times height, across all planes.

name: advance_audio_sound_sequences
description: Each tick it updates a playback counter for each of four audio channels and writes the result to that channel's volume register. For channels flagged active it reads 32-bit entries from a per-channel list: a clear top bit loads a value into the channel, otherwise a helper is called; when the list ends the channel is marked idle, and otherwise a countdown is decremented.

name: disable_audio_dma_channels
description: Sets the shared global to a fixed sentinel value and writes the low four bits to the DMA control register with the set bit clear, which disables DMA for the four audio channels.

name: dispatch_table_store_by_flags
description: Dispatches on flag bits in its input: if the top flag is set it calls another routine; if the next flag is clear it stores the shared global plus the input word times eighteen into an indexed table; otherwise it stores the input word into a table indexed by the shared global.

name: claim_free_slot_and_init
description: Scans up to four slots for one whose bit in a status byte is clear. If one is found it sets that bit in two status copies, writes the slot's initial position from two stored coordinates offset by minus one hundred and minus ninety, initialises its linked records and fields, and increments the shared counter.

name: init_slot_pair_records
description: Given a slot index and two base pointers, marks the slot's bit in both status bytes, initialises two matching record blocks with a fixed pointer, zero fields and positions offset from the stored coordinates, and increments the shared counter.

name: stub_return_stack_value
description: Does no work; it returns the value held in its stacked argument unchanged, so it behaves as a pass-through stub.

name: spawn_slot_from_free_bit
description: Looks for a free one of three slots by checking its bits in two status bytes. If one is free and a count check passes, it initialises the slot's record: a starting position chosen from one of two offsets by comparing a derived value with a stored coordinate, a pointer-table entry, a flag taken from the slot's parity, and two sets of fixed field values, then increments the shared counter.

name: retire_active_slot_entry
description: For a slot index below three whose active bit is set, it marks the matching bit in a second status byte, decrements the shared counter, and picks one of two fixed values depending on whether a record field equals two hundred fifty-six, calling a helper in the other case. It stores that value and the number one into the slot's entries, then calls a helper.

name: or_blit_four_columns
description: Runs four passes of eight-row writes: each byte written into the buffer is the bitwise OR of one byte from each of two pattern tables, with the table for each row chosen by a rotating mask bit, and rows are spaced by a row stride.

name: delegate_to_single_helper
description: Does no work of its own: it calls one other routine and returns.

name: mask_and_or_blit_columns
description: Runs four passes of eight-row writes: each destination byte has the bits of a mask cleared and is then ORed with a pattern byte, with the pattern table for each row chosen by a rotating mask bit.

name: delegate_to_nested_helper
description: Does no work of its own beyond calling one other routine and returning.

name: pass_through_helper_call
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no other work in its body.

name: emit_nibbles_via_callback
description: Walks the eight four-bit digits of a 32-bit value from most significant to least, skipping leading zeros but always handling the final digit, and calls a supplied routine through a pointer for each digit it emits.

name: emit_string_characters
description: Calls one routine for each byte of a zero-terminated string until the terminator; the branch on the mode word runs the same loop either way.

name: process_terminated_entries
description: Walks a list of entries that ends with a two-byte all-ones marker, calling one routine for each entry and then skipping that entry's zero-terminated string.

name: copy_offset_columns_to_planes
description: Copies an eight-row byte column for each of four planes from a source buffer to a destination. Both positions come from the input coordinates offset by the shared global value, stepping by each buffer's row stride.

name: or_composite_into_two_targets
description: If a selected four-bit field of a stored value is nonzero, or the index is at least two, it ORs eight row bytes from two selected pattern tables and writes the result into two destination buffers at offsets taken from two pointer tables.

name: extract_nibble_from_field
description: Returns a stored long value shifted right by four times the low nibble of the index argument, extracting one four-bit field from it.

name: run_conditional_call_sequence
description: Makes a fixed sequence of calls to helper routines, repeating some of them only while the shared counter is above one. One call takes a value computed from a stored word offset, and the routine ends by setting the shared counter to minus one.

name: call_helper_for_six_indices
description: Calls one routine six times in turn, passing it each index from zero to five together with the two arguments it received.

name: update_record_peak_and_flags
description: When a record's enable word and the shared flag are both nonzero, it stores a helper's result as the record's value, sets a first-crossing flag and bumps a counter at each of two fixed thresholds, then updates the per-record and overall maxima of that value.

name: pass_through_long_result
description: Calls one other routine and returns with the data-register values unchanged, so it forwards that routine's result to its caller.

name: add_packed_decimal_bytes
description: Adds two four-byte values as independent packed-decimal byte pairs, applying decimal adjustment to each byte sum. The code shows no carry passed from one byte to the next.

name: subtract_packed_decimal_bytes
description: Subtracts one four-byte packed-decimal value from another byte by byte, decimal-adjusting each result and propagating the borrow from lower bytes.

name: call_helper_three_times
description: Calls one unnamed routine three times in succession and returns, with no other work in its body.

name: setup_four_helper_pairs
description: Clears one word, calls a helper eight times, then four times calls it with two addresses that advance by four bytes per step, starting from a fixed table location and the shared global.

name: emit_calls_by_tag_marker
description: Makes a fixed run of helper calls and branches on whether a data register holds the four-byte marker spelling ALL followed by a zero byte: the matching branch makes one extra call, the other two. A final loop makes sixteen more helper calls.

name: store_word_then_call_pairs
description: Makes a helper call pair, writes the value one hundred ninety-two to a word at a fixed offset from the base register, then repeats eight pairs of helper calls.

name: call_pairs_advancing_word
description: Three times over, it makes two helper calls and then adds eight to a word at a fixed offset from the base register.

name: iterate_clipped_tiles
description: Walks a rectangle in steps of a tile size, clipping the last step at each edge, and calls one routine for each tile position. The width is the first word of the argument times eight and the height is the second word.

name: service_audio_channel_interrupts
description: Reads the audio interrupt and DMA status, and for each audio channel with a pending request either decrements its countdown or, once the countdown has run out, switches that channel's DMA off and marks it finished. It then clears the four audio interrupt request bits.

name: start_audio_channel_sample
description: Starts one audio channel: it marks the channel active, pauses briefly, loads the sample address, length and volume from a four-word block into the channel's registers, records bookkeeping values, and then enables that channel's DMA together with the DMA master enable.

name: pack_sprite_position_words
description: Packs an Amiga sprite's position into its two control words: horizontal start and vertical start and stop as bit fields, plus the high-bit flags, stored byte-swapped in the target block.

name: setup_sprite_pointer_and_control
description: Packs sprite position control words as its neighbour does, then stores the sprite data pointer as separate high and low words into one of two per-buffer tables chosen by the shared global, and writes the control words into a second table, offsetting the pointer when the input flag is set.

name: store_pointer_into_table_pair
description: Writes the high and low halves of a 32-bit pointer argument into the same index slot of two parallel tables.

name: decode_packed_parameter_word
description: Decodes a packed word into several parameters: it stores the word, scales a value by a table entry selected by the word's low byte, reads a long, a byte and a word from three lookup tables chosen by bit fields, and derives a final field from the word.

name: store_flag_or_input_word
description: Writes a word into two record fields. The stored word is one when the shared global is nonzero, otherwise it is the value passed in the data register.

name: blit_masked_rectangle_copy
description: Sets up the blitter for a masked rectangle copy between two bitmaps: it computes shift and first and last word masks from the horizontal coordinates, writes the modulo and pointer registers for source and destination, runs one blit per row waiting for each to finish, and writes the interrupt and DMA control registers at the end.

name: compute_bitplane_byte_offset
description: Returns the byte offset of a position within a bitplane: the row number times the row stride, plus the horizontal position rounded down to a multiple of sixteen and divided by eight.

name: forward_single_helper_call
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no other work in its body.

name: blit_rows_with_shifted_source
description: Sets up the blitter for a copy of a rectangle with a bit shift: it derives the shift and first-word mask from the horizontal coordinates, writes the modulo and pointer registers for the source and destination planes, and starts one blit per row, waiting for each to finish.

name: delegate_to_inner_routine
description: Does no work of its own: it calls one other routine and returns.

name: relay_single_call_wrapper
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no other work in its body.

name: redirect_to_helper_call
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no other work in its body.

name: configure_and_start_blit
description: Configures the blitter for one rectangle: it computes first and last word masks and the row modulo from the horizontal start and width, sets the copy control bits from a flag, starts a blit of the combined size, and then calls one routine twice.

name: build_clear_mode_register_word
description: Returns the bitwise complement of its word argument with the top bit forced on before inversion, so the result has its top bit clear. Written to a control register, this value clears the chosen bits.

name: blit_planes_by_mask_bit
description: Sets up the blitter for a rectangle and blits each bitplane in turn. For each plane, a bit of an input mask selects one of two blit modes, the destination and source addresses come from the coordinates and row stride, and each blit is waited on before the next. It then calls one routine twice.

name: invert_word_for_clear_write
description: Returns the bitwise complement of its word argument with the top bit forced on before inversion, so the result has its top bit clear, which makes a control-register write clear the chosen bits.

name: stub_return_no_work
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so it does nothing when called.

name: stub_return_no_op
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so it does nothing when called.

name: stub_return_empty_body
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so it does nothing when called.

name: stub_return_nothing_done
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so it does nothing when called.

name: stub_return_unused_slot
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so it does nothing when called.

name: check_id_then_patch_routines
description: Calls a function-table entry of a system structure to read an identifier and compares it against five fixed values; if none matches it passes control to a fallback routine. On a match it writes call and jump instructions that target local routines into several code locations, then issues a trap and makes a few further calls.

name: write_absolute_jump_patch
description: Writes a jump instruction and the routine address it targets into a block of memory, with a small constant word between them.

name: emit_vector_jump_patch
description: Writes a block of return, call and jump instructions, each followed by a routine address, into a memory table. The sequence written depends on whether a stored flag equals two.

name: emit_jump_patch_block
description: Writes a block of two return instructions followed by call and jump instructions, each followed by a routine address, into a memory table.

name: call_table_entry_then_return
description: Calls a function-table entry with three arguments and returns. A wait-forever branch that follows tests a value that is always zero, so it never runs.

name: return_fixed_constant_value
description: Does nothing but return the fixed decimal value thirty-nine million five hundred twenty-nine thousand four hundred twenty-five.

name: clear_flag_bit_in_record
description: Clears bit two of a flag byte at a fixed offset from a computed address, after masking that address to a fixed window, and leaves the data register unchanged.

name: halt_if_flag_else_store
description: Reads a shared flag word. If bit three is set it loops forever; otherwise it stores the constant twenty-four into the shared word.

name: check_save_signature_marker
description: Calls one routine and, if its condition flag is clear, calls another and compares two memory fields against the text SAVE followed by MS. On a match it returns the data-register value with a zero high half; otherwise it returns minus three in the high half.

name: verify_second_save_marker
description: Calls one routine and, if its condition flag is clear, calls another and compares two other memory fields against the text SAVE followed by MS. On a match it returns the data-register value with a zero high half; otherwise it returns minus three in the high half.

name: return_error_code_minus_three
description: Returns its argument in the low half of a 64-bit result with the high half set to minus three, the same error-style return used by its neighbours.

name: call_table_entry_no_args
description: Calls one entry of a function table with no arguments and returns the data-register values unchanged.

name: call_entry_after_marker_check
description: If a data register holds the text SAVE, it calls one helper first. In every case it then calls a function-table entry and returns the data-register value unchanged. The error return that the match path seems to offer can never be reached, because its flag is set to false before the test.

name: call_table_entry_skip_second
description: Calls a function-table entry with three arguments and returns the data-register value. A follow-up call to a second table entry is guarded by a value that is always zero, so it never runs.

name: run_setup_call_sequence
description: Makes a helper call, then two more calls, one passing a fixed address, stores the constant one hundred seventy-one into the shared word, and makes a final call.

name: trap_zero_then_call_sequence
description: Stores a routine address into the shared word, issues the processor trap instruction numbered zero, then makes a short sequence of calls, storing a fixed constant and two parameter words along the way.

name: init_chipset_registers_and_palette
description: Initialises the custom chip set. It writes a routine address into a block of low-memory vector entries, points the copper list at a shared buffer, clears eight sprite control words, and sets the display fetch start and stop, display mode bits, bitplane modulo and palette colours from a table. It also configures the CIA ports and the DMA and audio control registers, and returns a fixed value.

name: set_copper_list_pointer
description: Stores its second address argument into the copper list location register, which points the copper at a new list.

name: stub_return_do_nothing
description: Consists only of a return instruction. Its address is taken, so it may serve as an empty callback.

name: store_addresses_then_calls
description: Writes a pair of addresses and constants into two low-memory locations, makes two calls, stores a routine address and a constant in the shared words, then makes two further calls with fixed parameter words.

name: halt_in_infinite_loop
description: Loops forever with no exit, so it never returns.

name: forward_single_call_stub
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no other work in its body.

name: configure_cia_timer_interrupt
description: Sets or clears control bits on a CIA control register according to a status flag, writes a computed value to the timer, enables one interrupt source, and sets the shared word to a fixed value along with two fixed timer bytes.

name: start_cia_timer_countdown
description: Clears a stored pointer, sets bit three of a CIA control register, writes a fixed interrupt-control value, and loads two timer bytes with fixed values.

name: acknowledge_cia_interrupt_flags
description: Combines a stored byte with the CIA interrupt control register, calls a handler when one bit is set, and clears the acknowledged interrupt bits in that register.

name: clear_cia_port_bits
description: Checks bit one of a CIA port byte, sets the byte to all ones if that bit is set, then clears bits one and two of it.

name: save_masked_state_and_advance
description: Keeps only bits zero and two of the shared word, calls a routine, copies the masked value into a second shared word, increments a pointer-sized shared value and clears a further shared word.

name: set_shared_word_to_sixteen
description: Sets the shared word to sixteen and returns.

name: save_registers_to_context_buffer
description: Waits until the shared flag is zero, then copies a byte block from one shared buffer to another, backwards, and writes the processor register values and a return address into the top of that buffer. It finally sets the flag to 255.

name: save_context_from_second_entry
description: Waits until the shared flag is zero, then copies a byte block between shared buffers backwards and writes register values and a return address into the top of the destination. It finally sets the flag to 255. It is an alternate entry into the same save sequence.

name: trap_one_then_set_flag
description: Issues the processor trap instruction numbered one and then sets the shared flag word to 255.

name: store_then_overwrite_flag
description: Stores the seventh data register into the shared word and then overwrites that word with 255.

name: copy_block_and_count_entries
description: Copies a block of bytes from an input address into the shared region, with the length taken from an argument, then counts two-byte entries until it reaches the entry that points at a known routine, and stores that count in a shared word.

name: store_entry_count_word
description: Stores its word argument into the shared count word.

name: spin_forever_stub
description: Loops forever with no exit and never returns.

name: set_timeout_and_wait_flag
description: If a shared word is zero, sets a second shared word to nine thousand and waits until the shared flag byte is cleared.

name: arm_pending_request_slot
description: If one shared word is nonzero and another is zero, it calls a helper, then stores a value made from a high byte of 255 and the shared flag byte into the second word, and clears a third word.

name: arm_request_slot_unchecked
description: If a shared word is zero, it calls a helper, stores a value made from a high byte of 255 and the shared flag byte into that word, and clears a second word.

name: step_timer_request_state
description: A two-step state machine for a pending timer request. When the state word is not yet set, it sets the shared flag, marks the state, and loads the shared countdown into the timer's low and high bytes with a control bit set. Otherwise it clears the pending word.

name: start_timer_request_state
description: When the state word is zero, loads the shared countdown into the timer's low and high bytes, sets a control bit and the shared flag, and marks the state. Otherwise it clears the pending word.

name: clear_pending_timer_request
description: Records the current stack address in a shared word and clears the pending word.

name: load_timer_countdown_value
description: Sets a timer control bit, writes the shared control flag, and loads the low and high bytes of its argument into the timer's count registers.

name: run_if_flag_set
description: Calls one routine only when the shared flag byte is nonzero, otherwise returns.

name: copy_block_or_return_error
description: Returns an error code of minus eight when a shared word is zero. Otherwise it makes several helper calls and returns the last helper result. A block copy from a table, indexed by a word times five hundred twelve, sits behind a condition that can never be true, so it never runs.

name: relay_call_to_helper
description: Calls one other routine and returns.

name: store_result_into_indexed_slot
description: Saves its fifth data register into a shared word, calls a helper for a 64-bit result and a second helper with its low half, then stores the saved word into a table slot chosen from the seventh register word, reduced by three and scaled by four. The register word is made positive first when the third register is negative. It returns zero.

name: store_word_run_three_calls
description: Stores its data-register argument into a shared word and then makes three helper calls.

name: retry_loop_with_status_codes
description: A retry loop that repeatedly calls helper routines and increments a byte counter until it reaches eleven, then resets it. Status bits decide whether it continues, and it returns status codes of minus four, minus three or zero.

name: retry_loop_alt_entry
description: Alternate entry into the same retry loop as its neighbour, without the first store. It returns status codes of minus three or zero, with the same status checks.

name: return_status_minus_three
description: Returns the status code minus three in the high half of a 64-bit result, with its argument in the low half.

name: retry_loop_tail_status
description: Tail of a retry loop: it makes helper calls and increments a byte counter up to eleven, then returns zero or a status code depending on a status bit.

name: retry_counter_loop_variant
description: A variant of the retry loop that makes helper calls and increments a byte counter up to eleven, returning zero once its status tests succeed.

name: pass_through_after_two_calls
description: Calls two other routines and returns its stacked argument unchanged.

name: wrap_single_call_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns.

name: check_index_range_or_error
description: Checks that a signed input lies between minus six and minus three. If it does, it returns the result of a helper call; otherwise it returns the error code minus five.

name: scan_for_sync_with_status
description: Returns error codes of minus three or minus four when a status flag is not set or a status byte is nonzero. Otherwise it scans bytes, counting to eleven, and returns the result of a final helper call.

name: stub_return_empty_hook
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so it does nothing when called.

name: store_transfer_request_fields
description: Stores a 32-bit address argument, a 32-bit length argument and a 16-bit value, with its high byte, into fixed fields of a request block.

name: begin_track_read_request
description: Reads the stored address and length back from the request block, resets its counter and layout bytes to fixed values, and calls a helper with those fields. It then repeats a helper call with a byte counter until that counter reaches eleven, and clears the shared word.

name: stub_return_empty_callback
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so it does nothing when called.

name: prepare_disk_sync_write
description: Records a buffer pointer in the request block and programs disk DMA: it writes the disk sync word, sets the disk pointer, adjusts the disk control and length registers, and clears the disk-block interrupt request before a helper call.

name: program_disk_sync_registers
description: Writes the disk sync word into a buffer and programs the disk sync, pointer, control and length registers with fixed values, then calls a helper.

name: wait_for_disk_ready_bit
description: Makes up to fifteen passes, calling a helper and checking bit one of a status byte. When the bit is set it programs the disk DMA control values and returns zero. If the bit never sets, it still programs them and returns the argument unchanged.

name: update_status_byte_bit
description: Rewrites a control byte: it sets a group of status bits, clears the bit selected by the index argument, and sets bit two from the low bit of a helper result, then calls a helper.

name: copy_sector_block_to_buffer
description: Sets the shared word to 255, then copies one 512-byte block, made of thirty-two groups of four longs, from a source pointer into a buffer chosen by an index byte times 512. It advances the source pointer and reduces the remaining count by 512.

name: copy_sector_block_from_source
description: Copies one 512-byte block, made of thirty-two groups of four longs, from a source pointer to a destination pointer. It then advances the source pointer and reduces the remaining count by 512.

name: scan_sync_and_decode_sector
description: Scans a raw track buffer for the disk sync word, skipping repeated sync words, then checks the sector byte against the wanted value. On a match it decodes the following data longs into the destination buffer and returns zero, or a status code of 255 while data is incomplete. It returns minus seven when the scan limit is reached.

name: merge_masked_long_pair
description: Returns a bitwise combination of two longs: bits selected by the mask argument are taken from one long, combined with the masked bits of the other long shifted left by one.

name: call_two_helpers_in_order
description: Calls two other routines in sequence and returns.

name: advance_status_byte_then_call
description: Clears bit zero of a status byte, stores that byte plus one back into it, and calls one other routine.

name: write_word_wait_for_flag
description: Clears the wait flag, writes the low and high bytes of its argument to two device registers, then spins until another routine sets the flag.

name: enable_cia_interrupt_bit
description: Keeps the upper three bits of a control byte, sets bit three, and writes a fixed control value to the adjacent register.

name: sequence_two_routine_calls
description: Calls two other routines in sequence and returns.

name: clear_flag_write_word_bytes
description: Calls one routine, clears the wait flag, and writes the low and high bytes of its argument to two device registers.

name: scan_words_until_marker
description: If a stored marker word is nonzero, reads words through a helper until one equals that marker, calling a further helper on each value whose low bit is clear, then makes two more calls. The alternate branch that acts on a set low bit can never run.

name: scan_words_until_marker_alt
description: Alternate entry into the same marker scan, starting after its first call. It returns after two further calls.

name: clear_indexed_control_bit
description: Updates a control byte by clearing bit one, setting a group of control bits, and then clearing the bit chosen by the index argument.

name: clear_indexed_control_bit_alt
description: Updates a control byte by clearing bit one and setting bits three to six, then clears the bit chosen by the index argument.

name: select_index_and_poll_status
description: If a per-index byte is zero, marks it with 255, updates a control byte to select that index, and calls a helper. It then checks up to fifteen times whether a status bit has cleared, and returns the input word either way.

name: reset_control_byte_then_calls
description: Rewrites a control byte to a fixed pattern, calls one routine, makes twenty further calls, then returns its word argument.

name: pulse_control_byte_sequence
description: Writes a sequence of values to a control byte: it sets bit seven, sets a group of bits, clears most of them, then sets a second group, and returns its word argument.

name: set_indexed_control_bit
description: Clears a per-index entry, sets bit seven of a control byte, writes a fixed group of bits, clears and then sets the bit chosen by the index argument, and calls a helper.

name: match_name_pattern_bytes
description: Compares up to four bytes of two long arguments, stepping from the top byte down. A star character in the second argument, or a full four-byte match, returns minus five. The first mismatch returns zero.

name: invoke_helper_indices_three_six
description: Calls one routine for each index from three through six, then returns.

name: toggle_bit_then_restore_field
description: Saves a 16-bit field, calls a helper, stores the helper's result with bit one toggled back into the field, calls another routine, then restores the original field value.

name: toggle_indexed_control_bit
description: Clears the control-byte bit selected by the index argument, calls a helper, writes a status-dependent value to a per-index byte, sets the bit again, calls another routine, and restores the control byte. It returns the combined low word and bit.

name: start_request_if_ready

name: merge_shifted_mask_long
